source.title: Reverse Engineering Challenge - Flotte
source.description: Unlock the secrets of SIMD instructions and crack a binary in this reverse engineering challenge! We'll dive into static analysis with Ghidra to uncover the 'magic number' needed for the correct password. Watch as we tackle this crackme, featuring a special guest, and learn how to reverse engineer binaries step-by-step. Perfect for beginners and seasoned reverse engineers alike! Discover how to decipher complex algorithms and understand SIMD instructions in this engaging tutorial. 00:00 Introduction 01:00 Initial Triage 02:05 Static Analysis in Ghidra 12:32 Bruteforcing lol 13:38 Conclusion Resources: * **Download my VM here:** [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SvyC1C2AkuaC-FNWvY0_Bhh-OhzZ5pJb?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SvyC1C2AkuaC-FNWvY0_Bhh-OhzZ5pJb?usp=sharing) * **Download the binary here:** [https://www.crackmes.one/crackme/5aef385633c5d41ac64b492f](https://www.crackmes.one/crackme/5aef385633c5d41ac64b492f) (The binary is password protected: crackmes.one) **Connect with Me:** * **Instagram:** [https://instagram.com/jaybailey_216?igshid=12tatfhhvp5n5](https://instagram.com/jaybailey_216?igshid=12tatfhhvp5n5) * **Twitter:** [https://twitter.com/jaybailey216](https://twitter.com/jaybailey216) * **Mastodon:** [https://mastodon.social/@jaybailey216](https://mastodon.social/@jaybailey216) * **Buy Me A Coke:** [https://buymeacoffee.com/jaybailey216](https://buymeacoffee.com/jaybailey216) * **Patreon:** [https://www.patreon.com/jaybailey216](ht…
